url_fixture.format: NUL-terminated URL bytes plus native two-word reference

comparison_note: The same CPU that completed the real JNI/bootstrap sequence keeps the lazy builtin cache bytes before request entry. The actual two-word URL reference then advances the request beyond the empty-URL boundary; the the real callback reaches the ELF memcpy PLT and the probe supplies only its byte-copy ABI before returning through x30. No callback vtable, runtime dispatch page, or signer output is synthesized.
